# PINHOLES.md - appendix (not promoted after verification): single-link exposure that hinges on a short unconnected stretch   (generated by egress/pinhole_md.py)

STATUS OF THE EVIDENCE: quantified on Overture only; calibrated on two open documentation sets (Hays, Tehama: repairs never improve agreement, CALIBRATION.md) but NOT verified against any independent open road inventory, so pinholes are an appendix lead list, not a finding. Every row below is a CANDIDATE for verification, not a claim that a road is missing.

## Definition
Baseline: S30 = dwellings whose path to the arterial network crosses a bridge (single link) serving >= 30 dwellings. Repair at radius r (egress/sens_nearmiss2.py): every dead-end tip (degree-1 node, not a sink) is joined to the nearest road piece it does not already touch within r metres.
Per baseline single-link cluster (top-level bridge): `relieved_dw` = its dwellings that stop being S30 after the 50 m repair; `min_gap_m` = the shortest external repair distance that touches the cluster (tip inside -> piece outside, or the reverse). Code: egress/pinhole_list.py, pinhole_summary.py; tables/pinholes_<region>_r50.csv.

## 1. How much single-link exposure depends on short connections (relative cut of the S30 share; tables/latent_connection_sweep.csv)
| region | S30 baseline | cut at <=25 m | <=50 m | <=100 m | <=250 m (upper bound) | median repair distance at 100 m |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northern California | 10.7 % | 7.6 % | 19.3 % | 34.9 % | 46.3 % | 51 m |
| Eastern Oklahoma | 6.5 % | 3.2 % | 7.7 % | 23.3 % | 32.6 % | 55 m |
| Maricopa AZ (+Pima/Pinal/Coconino) | 9.8 % | 5.0 % | 15.9 % | 33.6 % | 40.6 % | 47 m |
| South-Central Texas | 10.5 % | 3.1 % | 10.8 % | 29.7 % | 38.9 % | 52 m |
| Eastern Washington | 7.5 % | 4.7 % | 10.9 % | 23.2 % | 34.5 % | 49 m |

Ranges over the five regions: <=25 m 3-8 %, <=50 m 8-19 %, <=100 m 23-35 %, <=250 m 33-46 % -> at least 54-67 % of the exposure survives even the most generous reconnection.

## 4. Independent calibration of the repairs (Hays County study; validation/validate_hays_repair.py, tables/validation_hays_repair*.csv)
```
Hays calibration of the latent-connection repairs: 57 neighbourhoods (26 published one-exit, 31 multi-exit); flag = share of the neighbourhood's buildings with a single route >= 0.5
repair radius | one-exit flagged (true positives) | multi-exit flagged (false positives) | AUC (share_single vs published one-exit) | mean share_single one-exit / multi-exit
  r=  0 m | 17/26 | 1/31 | AUC 0.854 (p=2.5e-06) | 0.684 / 0.189
  r= 25 m | 17/26 | 1/31 | AUC 0.854 (p=2.5e-06) | 0.683 / 0.187
  r= 50 m | 16/26 | 1/31 | AUC 0.842 (p=5.0e-06) | 0.649 / 0.174
  r=100 m | 11/26 | 1/31 | AUC 0.820 (p=1.8e-05) | 0.514 / 0.124
  r=250 m | 10/26 | 0/31 | AUC 0.806 (p=3.8e-05) | 0.495 / 0.104
GOLDENWOOD (published 3 exits): share single-route by radius r0=0.62, r25=0.62, r50=0.62, r100=0.61, r250=0.37
  baseline false positive GOLDENWOOD (exits 3): r0=0.62, r25=0.62, r50=0.62, r100=0.61, r250=0.37
documented one-exit neighbourhoods flagged at baseline that fall below 0.5 at r=250 m: 7: HIGHPOINTE, CEDAR OAKS MESA, ARROWHEAD RANCH, BUNKER RANCH, HERITAGE OAKS, LA CIMA, MEADOW PARK
```
Reading: repairs of <= 25 m change nothing in the independent check; 50 m costs one documented single-exit flag; >= 100 m erases 6-7 of the 17 documented single-exit flags with no gain on false positives -> the 100-250 m numbers in section 1 are an over-estimate and only the <= 50 m candidates are credible. The one documented multi-exit false positive (Goldenwood, 3 published exits) is NOT a short-gap case: it stays at 0.62 single-route up to 100 m.

## 5. Caveats that bound any claim
* r > 25 m is an upper bound: private drives, fences, terrain and gated emergency accesses are not excluded.
* Tips are matched to the nearest piece of the SAME scored-class graph (no service/track roads), so some 'gaps' may be service roads the graph deliberately ignores.
* Not yet compared with any reference network or imagery. Nearest related forum post: 35033 (Texas low-water-crossing closure with a 20 m near-miss filter).
* The scorecard cannot register any of this: its road component counts kilometres of arterial road only.

## 6. Reproduce
cd .../egress; `sh run_nm2.sh` (sweep; ~15 min for 5 regions, Texas ~8 min); `for R in northern-ca eastern-ok maricopa-az south-central-tx eastern-wa; do $PY pinhole_list.py $R 50; done`; `$PY latent_sweep_table.py`; `$PY pinhole_summary.py`; `$PY pinhole_md.py`.
